key.name: temperature-unit
key.description: Display temperature in celsius or fahrenheit

key.name: auto-collapse
key.description: Collapse the expanded island when another window gains focus

key.name: top-margin
key.description: Vertical offset of the island from the top of the screen (0-40). Default 0 for peninsula style.

key.name: shortcut-apps
key.description: Unused. Kept so existing installations still load. Honeycomb dots use honeycomb-items.

key.name: honeycomb-items
key.description: JSON list of shortcut dots. Each entry is an app ({"type":"app","app":"id.desktop"}) or a website ({"type":"url","url":"https://…"}).

key.name: show-volume-hud
key.description: Morph the island into a volume bar when system output volume changes

key.name: show-battery-banners
key.description: Show charging and low-battery peninsula banners

key.name: low-battery-percent
key.description: Show the low-battery banner when charge drops to this percentage or below while on battery (15, 20, or 25)

key.name: fingerprint-island
key.description: Experimental: morph the island during fprintd verification
